rationale_one_line: All eight presets are inside the 14-entry anti-repeat window, so a brand pack is required. HashiCorp's identity is deterministic infrastructure, state and policy-as-code on a near-black ground with chromatic product accents. Statewright is policy/state guardrails for coding agents. Terraform purple on black carries a state-machine schematic.
writing_tone_notes: Peer-to-peer build-in-public engineer voice. Declarative and structural. Show the phase-gated machine, then the consequence. Contractions where natural. Contrast carries the praise, never superlatives. Reserve Terraform purple for the accent line, the diagnose node and the close accent only.
do_rules: Lead the diagram with the plan -> implement -> test pipeline governed by a single state engine node.
State the thesis as a flat contrast: prompts are advice, the engine is law.
Land the 2-of-10 -> 10-of-10 result as the loudest beat, framed as determinism over scale.
Keep the 'statewright' held-subject wordmark anchored across every scene.
Use the fade register so the schematic reads as a calm technical exposition, not a hype cut.
dont_rules: Don't repeat the X caption's phrasing in any scene or in the Why-this-one.
Don't say 'Agents are suggestions, states are laws' verbatim anywhere (it's the project's own line) — paraphrase the idea.
Don't use a version number in any scene copy.
Don't flood the frame with purple — it's a single accent on black, never a fill.
Don't claim a benchmark number the dossier doesn't support; the only hard number is 2/10 -> 10/10 on the 5-task subset.
